name: Default
shortDescription: Personal internet radio station with an AI DJ that plays your Navidrome or Subsonic library over one shared Icecast stream and talks between tracks.

alerts.message: After the first start, open /onboarding and sign in as admin with the ADMIN_PASS value from the environment. The wizard needs a reachable Navidrome or other Subsonic server and an LLM provider (a local or cloud Ollama, or a hosted API key).
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
